message.name: BOSS_PIRATE_DESCR
message.value: The Pirate Captain has sunken so many times, that he is not afraid of water anymore. But you should…

message.value: This Illusionist has mastered the art of creating his own fake clones. Dangerous and tricky enemy.

message.value: Voodoo Shaman

message.name: BOSS_SHAMAN_DESCR
message.value: Shaman relies on pesky demons, which may teleport anywhere, if you attack them

message.value: Voodoo Shaman

message.value: You're battleing against 3 veterans and your time leaks away. If you are slow enough, you'll get only 5 seconds for your turn!

message.value: Baleog the Fierce

message.value: Wind Master

message.name: BOSS_WIND_MASTER_DESCR
message.value: Wind is not an ally anymore – it serves the Wind Master!

message.value: Wind Master

message.value: Master's Guard

message.name: BOT_NAME_WIND1
message.value: Wind Master

message.name: BOSS_SAMURAI_CAT_DESCR
message.value: This cat really has 9 lives! This duel's going to be a test of your endurance.

message.name: BOSS_MINER_DESCR
message.value: Genius of explosions, which base is well protected by enhanced mines.

message.name: BOSS_BURNING_ZOMBIES_NAME
message.value: Burning zombies

message.name: BOSS_BURNING_ZOMBIES_DESCR
message.value: This zombies were possesed by some powerful force. Are you prepared to meteorite shower?

message.name: TEAM_NAME_BURNING_ZOMBIES
message.value: Burning zombies

message.name: BOSS_SOUL_NAME
message.value: Wandering spirit

message.name: BOSS_SOUL_DESCR
message.value: The Spirit heals his carriers while trying to escape you. Don't give him a chance.

message.name: BOSS_GHOST_NAME
message.value: Ancient ghost

message.name: BOSS_GHOST_DESCR
message.value: Malicious creature, who managed to subdue the energy of lightning. You simply don't have a chance.

message.name: TEAM_NAME_GHOST_MAIN
message.value: Ancient ghost

message.name: BOT_NAME_GHOST_MAIN
message.value: Ancient ghost

message.name: BOSS_YAKUZA_DESCR
message.value: The gang members are tightly linked to each other. By killing one of them, you make others stronger.

message.name: BOSS_ROMEO_JULIET_NAME
message.value: Romeo and Juliet

message.name: BOSS_ROMEO_JULIET_DESCR
message.value: One of the best mercenary teams. Noone has unraveled their secret yet.

message.name: BOSS_KING_DEAD_NAME
message.value: Zombie King

message.name: BOSS_KING_DEAD_DESCR
message.value: You think you can handle the horde of zombies and King's black magic?

message.name: TEAM_KING_DEAD_MINIONS
message.value: King's guard

message.name: BOSS_REVIVED_CAPTAIN_NAME
message.value: Revived Captain

message.name: BOSS_REVIVED_CAPTAIN_DESCR
message.value: The Old Pirate has returned with extra powers! Revenge!

message.name: BOSS_SERGEANT_DESCR
message.value: Sergeant is protected by the loyal guard and brand new invisible guarding bots!

message.name: BOSS_FARMER_DESCR
message.value: It's not known exactly, what is grown by this Farmer, but he must be interrupted.

message.name: ENHANCEMENT_APPLE_NAME
message.value: Strange apple

message.name: BOSS_HUNTER_DESCR
message.value: The Hunter relies on his laser traps, which are impossible to escape from (as he thinks).

message.name: BOSS_MANIACS_DESCR
message.value: This creatures are skilled with their dreadful hooks – so keep the distance!

message.name: BOSS_GUARDIANS_DEPTHS_NAME
message.value: Guardians of depths

message.name: BOSS_GUARDIANS_DEPTHS_DESCR
message.value: The Earth itself battles for the Guardians! Don't even try to attack without a strong team!

message.name: BOSS_ENGINEER_DESCR
message.value: Inventor, who created a vault in ancient tomb. First wrong action will lead to your defeat!

message.name: BOT_NAME_ENGINEER_DROID
message.value: Protective droid

message.name: PROGRESS_BAR_ENGINEER
message.value: next droid

message.name: BOSS_ENGINEER_THIEVES_LASERS_DELAY
message.value: Laser generators activate in: %d rounds

message.name: BOSS_DARK_KNIGHT_NAME
message.value: Dark Knight

message.name: BOSS_DARK_KNIGHT_DESCR
message.value: Superior warrior protected by twilight. He creates his own army of acolytes with the only aim to destroy you!

message.name: BOSS_DARK_KNIGHT_TEAM_ACOLYTES
message.value: Dark acolytes

message.name: BOSS_PALADIN_DESCR
message.value: Warrior of light, wielding powerful magic for both attack and defense. Still you have advantage in numbers.

message.name: BOSS_HACKER_DESCR
message.value: When engaged in combat, Hacker relies on his protective field heavily. Seize control over generators and destroy him!

message.name: BOSS_THIEVES_NAME
message.value: Master thieves

message.name: BOSS_THIEVES_DESCR
message.value: They'll strip you of your weapons in a nick of time. And then you'll have to battle them with few remaining guns.

message.name: BOSS_THIEF_BOX
message.value: Stolen item

message.name: BOSS_PSIONICS_DESCR
message.value: Telepathist creates black holes, instantly destroying your units. Only ally's reflexes can save you!

message.name: BOSS_PHANTOMS_DESCR
message.value: Even if you overcome a fear, what about clones of yourself?

message.name: BOSS_ARCHDEMON_DESCR
message.value: Lord of the local hell. He'll trap you inside the cage, he'll put you in his chains, and… he'll laugh at you!.

message.name: BOSS_ASSASSIN_DESCR
message.value: Master of knife combat and stealth movement. You have to find a way to escape his deadly attacks.

message.name: BOSS_ALCHEMIST_DESCR
message.value: Alchemist is extremely dangerous in combat but only if he has some reagents to use.

message.name: BOSS_DRUID_DESCR
message.value: You're not allowed to stay still in this battle. Otherwise, you'll be overwhelmed by the force of the nature!

message.name: BOSS_DRUID_HELPER_FIRE
message.value: Keeper of fire

message.name: BOSS_DRUID_HELPER_POISON
message.value: Keeper of earth

message.name: BOSS_DRUID_TOTEM_FIRE
message.value: Fire totem

message.name: BOSS_DRUID_TOTEM_POISION
message.value: Poison totem

message.name: BOSS_PHARAOH_DESCR
message.value: Ancient priest, master of transmutation. A decent enemy, a bit overconfident though.

message.name: BOSS_CYBORG_DESCR
message.value: This magnificent snowy glen has been captured by alien technology. You have to burn this place out!

message.name: BOSS_JARL_DESCR
message.value: Jarl and his companions are protected from most kinds of attack. Your task is to break their shields by capturing the runes.

message.name: BOSS_JARL_HELPER_TEAM
message.value: Elemental thanes

message.name: BASE_RUNE_HINT
message.value: Physical and air damage

message.name: FIRE_RUNE_HINT
message.value: Fire damage

message.name: SHOCK_RUNE_HINT
message.value: Shock and frost damage

message.name: POISON_RUNE_HINT
message.value: Poison damage

message.name: BOSS_ARCHBOT_DESCR
message.value: What can be worse than a robot, who practices magic? Protection from fire and lightning will surely help!

message.name: BOSS_ENCHANTER_DESCR
message.value: Fire spirits and Voodoo magic – you'll have to work really hard to defeat this shaman!

message.name: BOSS_ENCHANTER_FIRE_SOUL
message.value: Fire spirit

message.name: BOSS_ARCHIVIST_DESCR
message.value: To be honest, you don't seem to have much chances. You won't even realize, what's killing you.

message.name: BOSS_ARCHIVIST_TEAM_BOT_2
message.value: Shadow squad

message.name: BOSS_EMPEROR_DESCR
message.value: All he commands now is a pile of terracotta soldiers. But don't think you can just come and claim his tresures.

message.name: BOSS_SCIENTIST_DESCR
message.value: Pretty soon you'll feel the power of science (and also of lightning and magnetism)!

message.name: BOSS_SYMBIOTE_DESCR
message.value: Thrash your friends to hurt your foe – that's the only way to overcome this lifeform!

message.name: GRAVITY_MASTER_DESCR
message.value: Bends the space around himself. Be very cautious or he'll just flatten you out!

message.name: BOSS_SOLAR_PRIEST_NAME
message.value: Solar priest

message.name: BOSS_SOLAR_PRIEST_DESCR
message.value: High and mighty cultist will shed some light on your incompetence as a player.

message.name: BOSS_ARCTIC_WARRIOR_NAME
message.value: Arctic warrior

message.name: ARCTIC_WARRIOR_SUPPORT_NAME
message.value: Frozen zombie

message.name: BOSS_BLACKSMITH_DESCR
message.value: He's able to smash atoms with his strikes. Don't stand between hammer and anvil!

message.name: BOSS_SOUL_MASTER_NAME
message.value: Soul master

message.name: BOSS_SOUL_MASTER_DESCR
message.value: He lived for more than century changing his physical vessel. It's impossible to stop him for such brat as yourself.

message.name: BOSS_SOUL_PART_NAME
message.value: Soul fragment

message.name: BOSS_REBEL_ROBOT_NAME
message.value: Rebellious robot

message.name: BOSS_REBEL_ROBOT_DESCR
message.value: Rumor has it that this model was developed to deal with bosses effectively. Who could think this machine would join them.

message.name: BOSS_FARMER.PROMPT
message.value: The Farmer has lots of protection, so it's better to use weapons that ignore armor.{br}Pick up apples before attacking – they are increasing yuor attack for a turn.{br}Don't let the boss pick up apples – they heal him!

message.name: BOSS_HUNTER.PROMPT
message.value: Don't touch lasers around you, they deal high damage.{br}Destroy laser generators with weapons like rifle or shuriken to remove barriers and move around.{br}Be aware of guarding bot!

message.name: BOSS_MANIACS.PROMPT
message.value: Hide behind the ground to evade hook attacks.{br}If you can't deal enough damage to kill bosses, try to sink them.

message.name: BOSS_MINER.PROMPT
message.value: Be careful with the mines – they jump on you!.{br}If it's hard for you to hit the boss with normal attacks, try to sink him.

message.name: BOSS_SAMURAI.PROMPT
message.value: Don't stay near water – the boss may teleport to you and drown you.{br}Use your jetpacks and teleports wisely, you'll have to run a lot after the boss.

message.name: BOSS_SERGEANT.PROMPT
message.value: The location is full with invisible guarding bots, don't walk around!{br}Boss's attack increases each turn, so you have to deal with him fast.

message.name: BOSS_BURNING.PROMPT
message.value: Be careful, the more zombies you kill, the more meteors will attack you next turn.{br}Try to hide in the bottom part of the map.

message.name: BOSS_SOUL.PROMPT
message.value: Each turn attack the enemy with the spirit to prevent their regeneration.{br}Don't waste time, the boss has high damage!

message.name: BOSS_SHAMAN.PROMPT
message.value: The boss heals both himself and allies, kill him first to prevent it.{br}To kill the demons faster you may use high damage attacks and poison.

message.name: BOSS_ILLUSIONIST.PROMPT
message.value: When boss's health drops lower, he creates more copies – try to finish him with one powerful attack.{br}Clones disappear of any damage – poke them with weapons that don't waste a turn to find a real one.

message.name: BOSS_VIKINGS.PROMPT
message.value: Hurry up, each turn you'll be given less time.{br}Destroy the ground towards the water and try to sink the enemies.

message.name: BOSS_PIRATE.PROMPT
message.value: Stay away from water – the ground goes down fast, and enemies use destructive weapons.{br}Don't try to drown the Captain, he will jump out of the water each time.

message.name: BOSS_WIND_MASTER.PROMPT
message.value: The wind makes your jumps unpredictable, but you may use teleports to move.{br}Kill the main boss first to stop the menacing wind.

message.name: BOSS_YAKUZA.PROMPT
message.value: Try to push enemies to one place and attack them together.{br}Don't leave Steel the last one, as he gets huge regeneration in this case.

message.name: BOSS_REVIVED_CAPTAIN.PROMPT
message.value: Don't spend weapons carelessly, you'll need them at the end of combat.{br}Try to get on a higher ground to evade meteor attacks.

message.name: BOSS_ROMEO_JULIET.PROMPT
message.value: To win you must finish the bosses on one turn, first leave them as little health as possible.{br}Watch out the poisonous revenge attack after unit who started the turn after you kill each of the bosses!

message.name: BOSS_KING_DEAD.PROMPT
message.value: It's wise to kill the main boss first to stop shadow bolt attacks.{br}Bring down the Summoner before trying to destroy the remaining zombies.

message.name: BOSS_GHOST.PROMPT
message.value: Frozenness will help you, decreasing freeze duration, and allowing you to evade the cloud.{br}You may use enemies as shields against lightning attacks.

message.name: BOSS_ENGINEER.PROMPT
message.value: Each turn you have to escape electric storm that appears on your character.{br}Look for safe places where lasers don't appear and attack the Engineer from there.

message.name: BOSS_GUARDIANS.PROMPT
message.value: Watch the earthquake bar, you must hide on a shelter platform when it's filled.{br}You can't use shelters if there are enemies nearby.{br}It's better to have full team to guard the shelters.

message.name: BOSS_DARK_KNIGHT.PROMPT
message.value: Don't leave the boss with little health, he may sacrifice an accolyte to heal.{br}Enemies battle back when hit, so don't attack from dangerous places.

message.name: BOSS_ALCHEMIST.PROMPT
message.value: Use undestructable ground to hide from attacks.{br}Reagents can be destroyed with any single attack.

message.name: BOSS_ARCHBOT.PROMPT
message.value: Boss may attack you by teleporting his assistants, so deal with him first.{br}Each turn you first have to dodge the homing energy bolt that may break your turn.

message.name: BOSS_EMPEROR.PROMPT
message.value: Do not attack strongly – the stronger you drop the boss, the faster he creates the warriors helping him.{br} Hide under the ground from any enemy attacks – you will be enough to be removed by his warriors.

message.name: BOSS_SCIENTIST.PROMPT
message.value: Damage control panels to disable the magnet.{br}Don't stay in air for too long, or you'll lose a turn.{br}Stay in the zone to evade lightning attacks.

message.name: BOSS_SYMBIOTE.PROMPT
message.value: The boss only looses health when you damage your own characters.{br}Destroy cocoons, they will heal you.{br}Watch out spawning flies when boss is low on health.

message.name: BOSS_BLACKSMITH.PROMPT
message.value: Don't hide deep in the ground, or it'll be hard to get out after anvil attack.{br}Don't stay near anvil – it explodes.{br}And don't approach the enemy, you'll lose a turn.

message.name: BOSS_SOUL_MASTER.PROMPT
message.value: Try to prevent the boss from gathering souls – they increase his health.{br}Hide from attacks under the ground, or your health will be depleted fast!.

message.name: BOSS_REBEL_ROBOT.PROMPT
message.value: Move frequently to evade attacks from mortars located on stage.{br}Weapons get a delay after you use one, so you may wish to adjust your backpack.

message.name: BOSS_PALADIN.PROMPT
message.value: Destroy the obelisk each turn to prevent boss from healing.{br}You can't evade sword attack, so hide from basic attacks to save your health.

message.name: BOSS_HACKER.PROMPT
message.value: Occupy control panels to remove protective field.{br}It's wise to have more characters than the number of control panels to be able to attack boss from any position.

message.name: BOSS_THIEVES.PROMPT
message.value: Attack enemies to get keys that can be used to unlock weapon crates.{br}Use the weapons with multiple attacks to get keys more effectively.

message.name: BOSS_TELEPATHIST.PROMPT
message.value: You must attack your allies with any weapon to save them from black holes.{br}Kill the Telepathist first to stop black holes and evade energy spheres!

message.name: BOSS_PHANTOMS.PROMPT
message.value: You have to act fast – each turn Phantoms create clones of your units.{br}The damage you deal to clones is reflected back on your characters – you can only sink them.

message.name: BOSS_ARCHDEMON.PROMPT
message.value: Each turn attack cages and chains that trap your allies.{br}Don't try to destroy traps yourself – you'll be heavily punished!.

message.name: BOSS_DRUID.PROMPT
message.value: Destroy fire totems each turn, they deal significant damage.{br}Always keep moving to evade spores created by boss during your turn.

message.name: BOSS_PHARAOH.PROMPT
message.value: Each turn the boss morphs to a random race, which gives him unique abilities.{br}Don't stand near kamikaze zombies, they may detonate.{br}Rabbit sarcophagus are the most dangerous – they fully heal the boss.

message.name: BOSS_CYBORG.PROMPT
message.value: Attack inactive parts of the switch to create a field on that side next turn.{br}Destroy batteries hidden in the ground as fast as you can to greatly reduce enemies' health.

message.name: BOSS_JARL.PROMPT
message.value: Gather runes to remove protection from that type of attacks.{br}Try to attack several enemies at once by pushing them together.

message.name: BOSS_ENCHANTER.PROMPT
message.value: Each servant creates a fire spirit that attacks you.{br}Spirits also protect the boss from any damage.{br}You also get twice as much damage, as you deal to the Enchanter, it may be wise to use low health units for powerful attacks.

message.name: BOSS_ARCHIVIST.PROMPT
message.value: Try to destroy the shadows first to make the battle easier.{br}To remove the protection from the boss you have to seek and destroy seals, that are recreated each turn.

message.name: BOSS_SOLAR_PRIEST.PROMPT
message.value: Deal the maximal possible damage each turn – constant damage won't allow you to last long.{br}Be careful when you finish an enemy surrounded by an energy field – it'll emit lots of dangerous particles.

message.name: BOSS_ARCTIC_WARRIOR.PROMPT
message.value: Collect the torches and use them to free frozen allies.{br}Frozen zombies can be damaged only with fire, and their destruction will cause ice shower.{br}When low on health, boss freezes himself to restore health – prevent this!

message.name: BOSS_ARCTIC_WARRIOR_DESCR
message.value: Strange seismic activity and temperature volatility is registered at the North pole. Go settle down whatever happens there!

message.name: BOSS_ASSASSIN.PROMPT
message.value: Assassin had lots of time to hone his dodge skills. Attack the boss with great caution!{br}Hide from the boss behind a ground, he may wipe your whole team with single attack.{br}The Assassin may suddenly teleport, watch your back!

message.name: BOSS_GRAVITY_MASTER.PROMPT
message.value: Boss is protected by gravity circle that repells all missiles.{br}The boss will create more circles as his health drops lower.{br}Enter the circles only for a moment, to attack boss! The more you are pressed by Gravity Master's field – the more hit points villain gets!

message.name: BOSS_DEVOTEE_MINION_NAME
message.value: UFO pilot

message.name: BOSS_DEVOTEE_DESCR
message.value: He came to oppress and humiliate. Don't dare to resist!

message.name: BOSS_DEVOTEE.PROMPT
message.value: Alien technology allows the boss to have infinite arsenal – don't be surprised by endless guarding bots, force fields and air strikes!{br}Hurry up – the land goes down fast, and your hit points are quickly depleted by lightning strikes!{br}And don't relax after you deal with the boss – you'll have to deal with reinforcements!

message.value: Queen of spiders

message.name: BOSS_QUEEN_SPIDERS_EGG
message.value: Scorpion egg

message.name: BOSS_QUEEN_SPIDERS_DESCR
message.value: The experiment with spider genes ended in disaster: arthropod monsters broke free! It's time to stop them!

message.name: BOSS_QUEEN_SPIDERS.PROMPT
message.value: Damage the traps to get your partner out of the cocoon and also to remove the defensive sphere from the Queen.{br}Be careful while attacking the Queen, if you don't want to attract the attention of the spider guard.{br}When the eggs appear, destroy them as soon as possible. Otherwise, additional minions will come out of them!

message.value: Revived zombies
